items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 30 May 2026 10:23pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 30 May 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over central Europe. Large and slow-moving area of low pressure in the mid-Atlantic.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 4 or 5, veering and decreasing West or Southwest 3 or 4 later tonight. Little change thereafter.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Patchy rain and mist patches at first, but clearing to the east overnight, then fair.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in any mist patches at first, then generally good from later tonight.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, backing South or Southwest 4 or 5 overnight into Monday. Little change thereafter.


##State of Sea##

Slight, soon building slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain, drizzle and mist patches from about dawn on Monday onwards.


##Visibility##

Good at first, then falling moderate or poor.
